notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Krenko.
You control at least one additional Goblin.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin tokens.
The Goblins enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes at least two times, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.
